# Terms that must never appear in a prompt or agent body.
#
# The golden rule is that every prompt works in *any* repository, so anything
# naming one specific service, product, or codebase belongs in an input rather
# than in the prompt text. Add a term here the first time it leaks.
#
# One term per line; matching is case-insensitive and whole-word.
# Category READMEs are not checked.
#
# Seed this with your own service, product, and codebase names, e.g.:
#
#   MyService
#   my-internal-codename
#   MyCompanyInternalTool
#
# NOTE: this file is public. Do not paste confidential identifiers here just to
# block them -- the denylist would then leak the very thing it guards. Keep
# entries to names that are already public (your service/product names), and
# handle non-public material with the rule in CONTRIBUTING.md instead: never
# reproduce a non-public control catalog, taxonomy, or standard in a prompt
# body; take it as an input and cite it by link.
